en.body:
We're excited to expand our engagement with the energy communities on Bluesky!  
  
This platform allows us to share insights, project updates, and key discussions. Bluesky provides a fresh space for collaboration and meaningful exchanges on decentralized renewable energy. Stay updated on EDGE’s latest activities by following us and joining the conversation!  
  
Find us @[sweet-edge.bsky.social](http://sweet-edge.bsky.social/)

[\-> Go to Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/sweet-edge.bsky.social)
